subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Relacionar elementos sonoros (sílabas, fonemas, partes de palavras) com sua representação escrita.

components.description_pt: Relacionar sílabas faladas a suas representações escritas correspondentes
components.description_en: Match spoken syllables to their corresponding written representations
components.cc_component_description: Match most consonant and short-vowel phonemes to their standard spellings

components.description_pt: Identificar a representação escrita de fonemas individuais em palavras simples
components.description_en: Identify the written representation of individual phonemes in simple words
components.cc_component_description: Represent phonemes in simple words using knowledge of letter-sound relationships

components.description_pt: Mapear segmentos de som de palavra falada em letras ou grupos de letras na forma escrita
components.description_en: Map sound segments of a spoken word onto letters or letter groups in its written form
components.cc_component_description: Represent phonemes in simple words using knowledge of letter-sound relationships

cc_matches.description: Spell simple words phonetically, drawing on knowledge of sound-letter relationships.
